sections.title: Part 1 — An email
sections.instruction: Write an email. Write 60-80 words. You have about 20 minutes for this part.

questions.body:
You recently attended a language course at a study centre in your city. The centre has asked you for feedback.

Write an email to the course manager. In your email you should:

  • say which course you took and when;
  • explain what you liked most about it;
  • suggest one thing the centre could improve.

sections.title: Part 2 — An essay
sections.instruction: Write an essay. Write 180-200 words. You have about 40 minutes for this part.

questions.body:
Some people believe that students learn better when they study online from home. Others think that classroom lessons with a teacher are more effective.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Support your answer with reasons and examples from your own experience.
